messages:
Janelle Rivera: Hey @people-ops — quick question. My mom is having surgery next week and I need to be home for the first 6 weeks of recovery. Can Redwood do a temporary 6-hour workday (instead of my usual 8) for ~8 weeks? I can still own my sprint tasks but mornings will be inconsistent. Thanks.

Ethan Brooks: +1 from me to explore this. Janelle has been hitting goals, and we can rearrange non-urgent meetings. @Maya (People Ops) can you advise on process/what you need?

Maya (People Ops): Hi @Janelle Rivera — thanks for the heads-up and glad your manager flagged it. We can start the ADA interactive process to evaluate a temporary schedule accommodation. Typical steps: 1) intake call, 2) medical documentation request (we can accept a short note from the surgeon/primary care), 3) draft a temporary accommodation agreement (dates, hours, on-call adjustments).

Janelle Rivera: Appreciate it. I can get a surgeon note by Friday. Ideally start reduced hours from Mon 2027-04-05 through end of May.

Sanjay (Comp & Ben): FYI re: pay/benefits — part-day adjustments don't change benefits eligibility for a temporary period, but if hours drop below 30/wk we need to check. If you expect <30, let us know.

Maya (People Ops): Good note @Sanjay. @Janelle Rivera could you confirm rough weekly hours? If it's 30+ we can keep full benefits and this will be an accommodation, not a leave.

Janelle Rivera: It'll be 30 hours/week exactly (6h x 5).

Lia (People Ops): Thanks — that helps. Quick next steps: (a) schedule a 30-min intake with me or @Maya this week, (b) upload any medical note to the HR portal (we'll provide a secure link), (c) manager and you draft coverage/oncall changes. I can draft the temporary accommodation doc once we have the note.

Ethan Brooks: For coverage: I can swap Janelle's late-day oncall weeks with Priya and reassign async review tasks. Janelle, can you post a quick sample schedule so we can share with the team? e.g.:

``
Mon–Fri 10:00–16:00 (core availability)
No recurring standup, async update in #team-updates
Oncall: exempt Weeks 1–3, resume rotating Week 4 (if cleared)
``

Janelle Rivera: That schedule works for me. "core availability" window is perfect. I'm okay skipping oncall first 3 weeks.

Maya (People Ops): Perfect. I'll set up the intake slot and send the secure upload link. Two notes: (1) we aim to complete the interactive process within 7 business days, (2) temporary accommodations are evaluated for feasibility and performance impacts — we pair with managers to set success criteria so there's no surprise.

Janelle Rivera: Thank you. Appreciate the support.

Ethan Brooks: Thanks team. I'll update the rota and draft the coverage plan; will cc @Lia when done. :thumbsup:

Maya (People Ops): Closing loop here — intake scheduled Thu 09:30, invite sent. If anything changes, ping this thread or DM. :wave:
